lines.text: The window was about to give.
lines.style: First-person survivor, low gravelly voice, tense and hushed, steady pace.

lines.text: The bathroom. The only door left with a lock.
lines.style: Breathless while running, urgent, no long pauses.

lines.text: The window in there was small.
lines.style: Low and quick, a little dry.
Quiet resolve, steady, a held breath before 'let go'.

lines.text: Dead cars everywhere. Doors open. Keys still inside.
lines.style: Hushed whisper while sneaking, eerie, steady pace, no long pauses.
Whispered dread, a short beat after 'opened', last words land heavy.
